confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Mexico City prices, not checked against live listings or venue prices. Restaurant, beer, coffee and cocktail anchors are more reliable than hostel and hotel anchors, which vary more by neighbourhood, season and booking channel. Cocktail and wine are direct estimates, not derived from beer. FX came from an RBA exchange-rate page search snippet; the live page was not opened directly and the 2026-10-16 value should be confirmed.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: large Latin American capitals with a mid-range tourist market (such as Bogota and Buenos Aires), adjusted upward for Mexico City's higher restaurant and hotel costs relative to those cities.
